facts.title: Senir's Observations
facts.decision: Retain the existing 218 prerequisite and the unverified pickup flag. A matching converted-baseline prerequisite does not prove that all live beta pickup conditions are modeled. Do not merge this quest with quest 420 of the same name.

facts.title: The Quarry's Smith
facts.decision: Retain the known boar objective and both item quantities. Copper Bars still lack a verified local objective location; neither a smelting assumption nor remote drop alternatives establish a Dun Morogh farming point.

facts.name: Toughened Boar Hide
facts.decision: Explicit drop relation supports the existing Scarred Crag Boar objective.

facts.name: Scarred Crag Boar
facts.decision: Existing map 1426 point (0.7087, 0.6135) is an actual published spawn representative, not a centroid. Converted-baseline coordinates still require current-client verification.

facts.title: The Treaty of Understanding
facts.decision: Retain the item starter and known Magni hand-in. No pickup coordinates are established by these quest fields.

facts.name: Treaty of Understanding
facts.decision: The selected generated item record supplies no drop or vendor location. This is missing evidence, not proof that the item cannot drop.

remaining_needs.evidence_needed: Current beta complete NPC offers and consistent completion/character context before and after the suspected unlock.
An explicit applicable Copper Bar acquisition source and its published local position; preserve the existing boar location.
Explicit Treaty item acquisition relation and location, or a labeled current-beta item pickup observation.

limitations: Selected factual fields only; no upstream code or quest prose copied or executed.
